name: Cash Availability
definition: Indicates when the amount of money will become available, ie can be accessed and start generating interest.

NumberOfDays.name: Number Of Days
NumberOfDays.definition: Indicates the number of float days attached to the balance.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the availability balance is a credit or a debit balance. A zero balance is considered to be a credit balance.

CashBalance.name: Cash Balance
CashBalance.definition: Cash balance for which the availability is provided.

CashEntry.name: Cash Entry
CashEntry.definition: Specifies the cash entry for which the availability information is provided.
